decisions.reason: ERC-721C marketplace controls do not change which book access, referral identity, badges, or prize-ticket state follows the NFT after transfer.
Choosing ERC-721C and OpenSea Creator Controls does not change the confirmed Base network deployment.
The source changes royalty-enforcement technology and marketplace policy but does not alter any required metadata field or presentation rule.
The current FAQ state does not specify ERC-721 versus ERC-721C or a marketplace whitelist, and the source does not require new FAQ copy.
The NFT standard and secondary-market royalty controls do not change the deferred Transak fiat-minting flow.
Using ERC-721C does not change the asset's NFT-ebook format or unlimited edition supply.
The About-page state contains only generic smart-contract and secondary-sale descriptions and does not require disclosure of ERC-721C or marketplace whitelisting.
ERC-721C retains ERC-721 ownership semantics, so Lit Protocol's Base NFT ownership check and holder-gated access remain valid unchanged.
Royalty enforcement supports collection of secondary royalties but does not change the Small Block prize values, trigger, allocation, or existing rule that royalties contribute to its pool.
The secondary-market royalty standard does not change automatic prize payout behavior.
The ERC-721C choice does not change the token serial used as the permanent referral code or any of its display locations.
The NFT standard and secondary-market controls do not affect the selected badge set, icons, or presentation.
